What does Hamas's founding charter state.answer: The 1988 Hamas Charter defines all of the Land of Israel (from the river to the sea) as an inalienable Islamic religious endowment (waqf), calls for the destruction of the State of Israel, contains harsh antisemitic expressions, and firmly opposes a political solution and the peace process, emphasizing armed jihad as the only path to liberation.
